answer: Re-attestations are stored in knoll and reef lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the trellis graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1034 impostors cost 1181 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
